raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Serving Kimi-VL, MiniCPM3 or MLA DeepSeek-VL2 with `--attention-backend flashinfer` fails while the backend is built:

```
AttributeError: 'ModelConfig' object has no attribute 'scaling'
```

The `KimiVLForConditionalGeneration`, `MiniCPM3ForCausalLM` and `DeepseekVL2ForCausalLM` (`use_mla=True`) branches of `ModelConfig._derive_model_shapes` select `AttentionArch.MLA` but never set `scaling`, and `flashinfer_mla_backend.py:856,1000` reads `model_runner.model_config.scaling` unconditionally. This is still the case on main `4eb606b2a`.

Fixes #29891 (closed by the stale bot; the bug is still on main).

## Modifications

1. KimiVL and DeepseekVL2 set `scaling` through the shared `_init_mla_scaling`, so a YaRN `rope_scaling` on their text config applies the mscale correction, as for DeepSeek.
2. MiniCPM3 sets `scaling = 1 / sqrt(qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim)` and copies `qk_nope_head_dim`. Its checkpoints ship a `longrope` `rope_scaling` with no `factor` (for example `openbmb/MiniCPM3-4B`), and `models/minicpm3.py` uses `qk_head_dim**-0.5` without mscale, so the YaRN path would be wrong for it and would log "rope_scaling missing 'factor'". This follows the BailingMoeV3 branch.
3. `test_model_config_shapes.py` covers the three branches, a YaRN KimiVL config and a MiniCPM3 longrope config, and checks that none of them logs a warning.

No backend, server or dependency change.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A for model outputs: these configurations failed at backend construction before, and nothing else changes.

On `3814e0235` (main `4eb606b2a`), `python3 test/registered/unit/configs/test_model_config_shapes.py`: Ran 9 tests, OK. The same test file on main errors with `AttributeError: 'ModelConfig' object has no attribute 'scaling'`. With the previous MiniCPM3 line (`_init_mla_scaling`), the longrope case fails on the missing-factor warning. With the real `openbmb/MiniCPM3-4B` config.json, the branch gives `scaling` 0.10206, equal to `96**-0.5`, with no warning.

An earlier version of this PR served Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct on the FlashInfer MLA backend on an RTX PRO 6000 (SM120); that run was not repeated on this head.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: config-only change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A: no user-facing change.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A: config-only, no kernel change.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -157,6 +158,48 @@ def test_quant_config_objects_are_normalized(self):
 
         self.assertEqual(_quant_config_to_dict(quant_config), {"quant_method": "test"})
 
+    def test_mla_branches_derive_scaling(self):
+        base_scaling = 1 / math.sqrt(128 + 64)
+        rope_scaling = {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2.0, "mscale_all_dim": 1.0}
+        # MiniCPM3-4B ships longrope with no 'factor'.
+        longrope_scaling = {
+            "type": "longrope",
+            "long_factor": [1.0, 1.5],
+            "short_factor": [1.0, 1.0],
+            "original_max_position_embeddings": 32768,
+        }
+        cases = [
+            ("KimiVLForConditionalGeneration", {}, base_scaling),
+            ("MiniCPM3ForCausalLM", {}, base_scaling),
+            ("MiniCPM3ForCausalLM", {"rope_scaling": longrope_scaling}, base_scaling),
+            ("DeepseekVL2ForCausalLM", {"use_mla": True}, base_scaling),
+            (
+                "KimiVLForConditionalGeneration",
+                {"rope_scaling": rope_scaling},
+                compute_mla_mscale_scaling(rope_scaling, base_scaling),
+            ),
+        ]
+
+        for arch, extra, expected_scaling in cases:
+            with self.subTest(arch=arch, rope_scaling=extra.get("rope_scaling")):
+                config_kwargs = dict(
+                    architectures=[arch],
+                    kv_lora_rank=512,
+                    qk_nope_head_dim=128,
+                    qk_rope_head_dim=64,
+                    v_head_dim=128,
+                    rope_scaling=None,
+                )
+                config_kwargs.update(extra)
+                text_config = _make_text_config(**config_kwargs)
+                with self.assertNoLogs(
+                    "sglang.srt.configs.model_config", level="WARNING"
+                ):
+                    model_config = self._derive_shapes(text_config)
+
+                self.assertEqual(model_config.attention_arch, AttentionArch.MLA)
+                self.assertAlmostEqual(model_config.scaling, expected_scaling)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
